description:
Come Join Us! 

 From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects  here .

 Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

 What You'll Get to Do 

 Join a team where precision meets purpose. As a Production Engineer, you are the trusted link between what a customer ordered & what actually gets built. You'll take complex glass, glazing & architectural metal orders and turn them into precise, actionable instructions that manufacturing, procurement & project management can execute with confidence. This is a position that's deeply respected across the company because getting it right protects schedules, budgets & customer relationships.

 Responsibilities: 

 

 
 Build deep product & accessory expertise you'll rely on to guide every order

 Interpret customer contracts & enter orders into our engineering database with precision

 Produce verification documents & technical drawings (breakform, fabrication & glass) that manufacturing & purchasing depend on

 Partner with Project Management on order questions & customer reviews, keeping everyone informed

 Source competitive quotes through procurement & vendor partners for panels, breakform & security screens

 Compare quoted vs. ordered jobs, flag variances & drive change orders alongside Sales & Project Management

 Maintain accurate records that support Finance & Accounting

 Pitch in wherever needed across Process Engineering, because this team grows together

 
 What We’re Looking For 

 We welcome candidates from all backgrounds & career paths who bring curiosity, precision & a collaborative spirit. 

 You'll thrive here if you have:

 
 An associate's degree in a technical field (like Engineering) is a plus, or equivalent hands-on experience in order processing, drafting or project administration

 Strong math, keyboarding & attention-to-detail skills (precision is critical)

 Comfort reading technical, product & construction drawings

 Working knowledge of Excel, Word, Access & CAD (AutoCAD experience is a strong plus)

 Prefer experience in the fenestration, glass or architectural metals industry

 Familiarity with SoftTech V6 or similar order-entry/management systems 

 The ability to learn fast & retain a high volume of technical detail

 
 

 
 Position Pay Range 
 $50,000 — $65,000 USD 


 What OBE Offers You 

 
 Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive  benefits  at the lowest cost to the employee

 Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose

 Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses

 Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

 
 OBE Privacy Policy 

 OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.
